scope: Qualification of the FastNER Beta 1 candidate (CRF, tag beta1-candidate-1). Evaluation only: no candidate code, corpus, evidence or evaluator semantics are changed here.

declared_before_results.statement: This file is committed before any Beta 1 artifact is ingested or evaluated by fnbench. Support-gate thresholds are the existing gate set 0.3.0, unchanged.
declared_before_results.prior_exposure: The author had read the headline numbers in the FastNER hand-off and ner-eval's Beta 1 README (strict F1 0.80, ECE 0.15) before writing it. Round-number thresholds below were not fitted to them.

outcomes.A: BETA 1 FAIL: fix the Beta 1 candidate (or the measurement) and re-measure
outcomes.B: BETA 1 ACCEPT: plan Beta 2 from the measured deficits
outcomes.C: BETA 1 ACCEPT + PROVISIONAL SUPPORT: Beta 2 plus provisional status for the profiles that qualify

decision_rule: A if any hard check in stages 0-4 fails. Otherwise C only if every provisional condition holds for at least one profile; otherwise B. Failing support gates are deficits, not hard failures. `stable` is never an outcome.

checks.text: Candidate pin has runtime git tag + commit + crate tree hash, model directory digest, per-file SHA-256, model version, adapter versions; all runtime and model identities in the ner-eval artifacts equal the pin
Beta 1 snapshot id, content digest, case count and fixture count in every artifact equal the pinned identity and the digest published in ner-evidence's snapshot index
Product corpora and the candidate-specific corpus measured by ner-eval have the content digests of the committed corpora
Reference and control model digests equal the Alpha pins
ner-eval plan verification is identical with zero differences; one evaluator version, one measurement protocol, one slice spec and one hardware class across the plan; every adapter run ok
The native and shim adapters carry identical model digests
Candidate class is B (linear model + CRF) with default feature cand-crf
ADR-0002 (promotion) is promoted on fastner main and the Beta 1 ADRs (0003, 0004) exist accepted on fastner main
Model size grows by at most 5% and WASM runtime code by at most 10% over the Alpha CRF

stages.title: Quality gates

checks.text: Native and shim quality results are identical on every population
On each product corpus (same corpus digest as the Alpha measurement), strict precision, recall, F1 and EN/KO slice F1 are no more than the tolerance below the Alpha CRF
At least one comparable support gate (regression EN/KO F1, adversarial EN/KO precision) improves by more than the tolerance

informational: support gates (gate set 0.3.0) evaluated with 95% intervals

checks.text: Calibration artifacts are ok for native and shim, identical to each other, with at least the minimum number of scored predictions on the quality floor

target_gate.why: confidence shown to users should not be far above accuracy

checks.text: Every budget gate has a value; a value that is only candidate-reported (not measured by ner-eval) is allowed for ACCEPT and marked as such
Repeat spread (max/min) of the throughput median is at most the bound below, else the value is inconclusive

provisional_conditions: every support gate passes (gate set 0.3.0 + calibration.ece)
no passing quality gate straddles its 95% interval (inconclusive gates block provisional)
every size/performance gate value is measured by ner-eval, not candidate-reported

quality gates are evidenced on at least one population that was not used for selection (a protected holdout or an independently reviewed snapshot); the Beta 1 snapshot and the product corpora do not count
fastner ADR promotion is on main and the gate ratification record exists

alpha_baseline.note: Only the two product corpora were measured at Alpha with the same digests, so only they support a like-for-like comparison. The Beta 1 snapshot differs from the Alpha snapshot and is not compared.

added.note: added at Beta 1 qualification; ratified under the same delegated authority and limits as gate set 0.3.0

clarifications.text: 'Identical' native vs shim calibration is operationalized as equal within an absolute 1e-6 on every statistic (counts exactly). The first evaluation run flagged a mismatch of about 1e-8 caused by float rounding in the JSON-pipe transport of confidences.
clarifications.effect: No threshold, tolerance or outcome criterion was changed. The other hard check that failed in the same run (no_regression_vs_alpha) is NOT clarified or relaxed: the 0.02 tolerance stands.
